---
title: "Get started with surveyframe, no coding needed"
description: "Install surveyframe in R, then open a complete survey study in SurveyStudio from RStudio's Addins menu, in about 5 minutes."
---

surveyframe runs a survey study from the questionnaire to the APA 7 report in
SurveyStudio, a window that opens from R. You need R and RStudio, both free,
and 2 steps.

## 1. Install surveyframe

Open RStudio and run this line in the Console:

```r
install.packages("surveyframe")
```

## 2. Open a study

In RStudio, open the **Addins** menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo**, and
pick a study. It opens in SurveyStudio on the Design screen, with its
questionnaire, analysis plan and demonstration responses loaded, so every
stage has something to show.

![SurveyStudio's Design screen.](../studies/paired/design.png){width=100%}

To start your own study, choose **surveyframe: Open analysis workspace** from
the same menu and go to Design.
